output_list.criticism: The function _transfer in the contract DYC has a vulnerability of Integer Overflow. The reason is that the function does not check the maximum value of the balanceOf[_to] before adding the _value. This can lead to a situation where the balanceOf[_to] becomes larger than the maximum value of uint256, causing the program to crash.

The function _transfer in the contract DYC has a vulnerability of Integer Overflow. The reason is that the function does not check the maximum value of the balanceOf[_from] before subtracting the _value. This can lead to a situation where the balanceOf[_from] becomes larger than the maximum value of uint256, causing the program to crash.
